exercises.passage: Last spring, the eighth graders of Ramon School went on a three-day trip to the Negev desert. On the first night, their guide, Eli, woke them up at two in the morning. "Bring your coats and follow me," he said. Nobody understood why, but they walked quietly behind him to the top of a small hill. When they looked up, they could not believe their eyes. The sky was full of thousands of stars. "In the city we can't see them because of the lights," Eli explained. Some students lay on the cold sand and tried to find shapes in the sky. Noa, who usually hates getting up early, said it was the best night of the whole year. Before they went back to sleep, Eli asked everyone to stay silent for one minute and just listen. "That is the sound of the desert," he said. "Silence."
exercises.question: Where did the students go?
exercises.explain_he: בהתחלה כתוב: went on a three-day trip to the Negev desert.
